title: Tom and Anna
text:
Tom is very active. He plays football with his friends every day. He runs fast and jumps high. On Sunday, he swims in the lake with his dad.

Anna likes quiet games. She reads books and draws pictures. In the evening, she cooks dinner for her family. Then she goes to bed early.

questions.text: What does Tom do with his friends every day?
What does Anna do in the evening?
options: She cooks dinner for her family

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom?
options: An energetic person who likes sports
A person who hates the outdoors
A shy person who stays at home
A person who never plays games

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna?
options: She prefers calm activities at home
She is a famous football player
She loves swimming in cold lakes
She runs in the park every morning

vocabulary.definition: doing many things and moving a lot
makes a picture with a pencil or pen

paragraph_translations: Tom es muy activo. Juega al fútbol con sus amigos todos los días. Corre rápido y salta alto. El domingo nada en el lago con su papá.
A Ana le gustan los juegos tranquilos. Lee libros y dibuja imágenes. Por la noche, cocina la cena para su familia. Después se acuesta temprano.
